QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_66

question.text: SCORES covers complaints arising under which of the following legislations?

answer.text: Only the SEBI Act and SCRA
SEBI Act, SCRA, Depositories Act, and Section 26 of the Companies Act
SEBI Act, RBI Act, and IRDA Act

explanation.text: The Logic: SCORES handles complaints arising under the SEBI Act, the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act (SCRA), the Depositories Act, and the rules/regulations made thereunder, as well as provisions covered under Section 26 of the Companies Act. SCORES does not extend to matters administered by other regulators such as RBI or IRDAI. The Trap: The first option is incomplete because it omits the Depositories Act and Section 26 of the Companies Act. The second option is too narrow. The fourth option is wrong because RBI and IRDA legislations fall outside SCORES jurisdiction. Note: Distributor/cross-exam framing removed; explanation now uses direct source-backed jurisdiction wording.
